text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — main just flipped red after the auto-merge (PR #2193 by janet). Smoke-gpu allocator step failing.
Ben Cho: On it, grabbing the pipeline logs now.
ci-bot: Pipeline 9821 failed in stage `smoke-gpu` (exit 1). https://ci.internal/9821
Riley Kim: Which test/step exactly? smoke or e2e?
Maya Patel: smoke -> `allocator` step. Quick snippet: ```AllocatorError: failed to reserve 8G -- node gpu-14a```
Ben Cho: Any allocator changes in that PR? Janet, did you touch prefetch/alloc heuristics?
Janet Li: I only changed prefetch threshold for large-batch loads, shouldn't touch allocator fallback. I'll look immediately.
Ava Sundaram: If it's GPU OOM, try rerunning on a different shard: `/ci rerun 9821 --shard=3`
Ben Cho: Rerun requested: https://ci.internal/9821/rerun/1 (shard=3)
ci-bot: Rerun started (shard 3).
Ava Sundaram: Also pinging @SRE Oncall in case this is cluster pressure / node eviction related.
SRE Oncall: I'm seeing two GPU nodes in us-west-2 go NotReady ~2m ago, likely kubelet restart after patch rollout. Looking into cluster-level drains.
Maya Patel: That would explain transient OOMs if pods got squeezed. Hold bisect until SRE confirms?
Ben Cho: Rerun finished: failed with same allocator error.
Riley Kim: Ok proceeding with quick bisect if cluster pressure isn't the cause: `git bisect start --first-parent 4319800000 HEAD`
Janet Li: If bisect points to my change I'll open a revert immediately. Drafting revert PR now.
Ben Cho: If revert needed, I'll cut it and request a hotfix pipeline run.
Maya Patel: Thanks all — status update after bisect or SRE confirmation. :thumbsup:
Riley Kim: (bisect in progress, will post shortlist of suspect commits shortly)
SRE Oncall: Cluster issue mitigation in progress, evicted nodes are rejoining. Will confirm when stable.
Janet Li: Revert PR prepared in draft: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/2301 (WIP)
Ben Cho: Great. If cluster stabilizes and rerun passes, we can close this. If rerun still fails, proceed with bisect + revert plan.
Maya Patel: Looping in oncall rotation: @SRE Oncall please follow up in #incidents if this becomes widespread.
ci-bot: Note: last green build on main was 4319800120.
Riley Kim: Posting bisect results now — will update root thread when done.
